issues.description: The solution's Developer initializer includes an extra parameter (age: Int) that is not present in the problem statement or the template. The problem asks for init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?), and the template provides that signature. The extra age parameter in the solution deviates from the specified design and would confuse students comparing the solution to the exercise description.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution initializer with the problem and template by removing the extraneous age: Int parameter. The initializer should be init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?) and should set properties and print the swiftExperienceDescription() as required by the task.

issues.description: Within the solution repository there is an internal inconsistency: Client calls Developer(name:monthsOfSwiftExperience:) but the solution's Developer initializer signature requires an additional age parameter. This mismatch will prevent the solution code from compiling and confuses the intended usage of the Developer initializer.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution self-consistent: either update all Client calls to pass the additional age argument, or (preferably) remove the unnecessary age parameter from Developer.init so Client usage matches the initializer. The preferred fix is to remove age from the initializer to match the exercise specification and the template.

issues.description: The Developer initializer signature is inconsistent across artifacts: the Problem Statement and Template expect an initializer taking (name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?), but the Solution adds an extra parameter 'age' (init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?, age: Int)). This changes the expected API for constructing Developer instances and creates confusion mapping the requirement to the reference implementation (the Solution's Client also constructs Developer without the extra parameter, indicating an unintentional mismatch).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the Solution with the Problem and Template by removing the extra 'age' parameter from the Developer initializer. Change the Solution initializer to init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?) and update any internal calls accordingly (or, alternatively, update the Problem and Template to document and use the extra parameter if its inclusion is intentional).
